name: Salesforce REST OAuth
description: Loads Salesforce data through OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials and the REST SOQL Query API
introductoryText:
### Salesforce REST connector (OAuth 2.0)

Loads Salesforce data. Authentication uses the OAuth 2.0 **Client Credentials** flow, which is suitable for a headless Omniscope workflow.

#### Salesforce setup
1. In Salesforce Setup, create/configure an **External Client App** with OAuth enabled and the **Manage user data via APIs (`api`)** scope.
2. Enable the **Client Credentials Flow** and configure its **Run As** user in the app policies. That user's Salesforce permissions determine which objects/fields this block can read.
3. Copy the External Client App **Consumer Key** and **Consumer Secret** into the options below.
4. Use your Salesforce **My Domain URL**, e.g. `https://your-company.my.salesforce.com`.

#### Operations
- **Query data**: use the visual query-builder options or paste custom SOQL. Results are retrieved through the synchronous REST Query API and automatically follow `nextRecordsUrl` pages.
- **List available objects**: useful for discovering object API names.
- **Describe fields**: returns field metadata for one object.

**Notes:** REST API access must be enabled for the Salesforce org/edition. Secrets are masked by Omniscope password options.

options.name: authBaseUrl
options.title: Salesforce My Domain URL
options.description: HTTPS My Domain URL used for OAuth, e.g. https://acme.my.salesforce.com. My Domain is recommended for External Client Apps.

options.name: clientId
options.title: Client ID / Consumer Key
options.description: Consumer Key from the Salesforce External Client App OAuth settings.

options.name: clientSecret
options.title: Client Secret / Consumer Secret
options.description: Consumer Secret from the Salesforce External Client App. Omniscope masks this value.

options.name: operation
options.title: Operation
options.description: Choose whether to load Salesforce records or inspect available schema metadata.

options.name: queryMode
options.title: Query mode
options.description: Query Builder constructs a basic SELECT statement. Custom SOQL supports relationships, aggregates and other SOQL syntax.

options.name: objectName
options.title: Object API name
options.description: Salesforce object API name, e.g. Account, Contact, Opportunity or MyObject__c. Also used by Describe fields.

options.name: fields
options.title: Fields
options.description: Comma-separated field API names for Query Builder mode. Relationship fields such as Owner.Name are supported.

options.name: whereClause
options.title: WHERE clause
options.description: Optional Query Builder WHERE expression without the word WHERE, e.g. CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:30.

options.name: orderBy
options.title: ORDER BY clause
options.description: Optional Query Builder ORDER BY expression without the words ORDER BY, e.g. CreatedDate DESC.

options.name: soql
options.title: Custom SOQL
options.description: SOQL used when Query mode is Custom SOQL, e.g. SELECT Id, Name, Owner.Name FROM Account.

options.name: includeDeleted
options.title: Include deleted/archived records
options.description: Uses the REST queryAll resource instead of query. Relevant only to Query data.

options.name: maxRecords
options.title: Maximum records
options.description: Connector-side safety cap across all REST pages. Use 0 for no connector-side cap.

options.name: apiVersion
options.title: REST API version
options.description: Use 'auto' to discover the latest REST API version exposed by the org, or specify a version such as 67.0.

options.name: timeoutSeconds
options.title: HTTP timeout (seconds)
options.description: Timeout for each OAuth/REST request. Transient 429 and 5xx responses are retried automatically.
